```{r}
# Load Libraries
library(readxl)
library(randomForest)
library(dplyr)
library(pROC)
library(caret)
library(ggplot2) 
library(rpart)
library(rpart.plot)
require("ggfortify")

#Load Data
team <- read_excel("Soccer_Data.xlsx", sheet = 2)
player <- read_excel("Soccer_Data.xlsx", sheet = 1)

colnames(team)
colnames(player)

# Success = Top 10 Standing
player$Success <- ifelse(player$Standing <= 10, 1, 0)
player$Success <- as.factor(player$Success)
team$Success <- ifelse(team$teamRank <= 10, 1, 0)

```

```{r}
# ALL appearances

# Select Numeric Predictors
columns_to_keep <- c("Success", "totalGoals_value", "goalAssists_value", 
                     "yellowCards_value", "redCards_value", "appearances_value", 
                     "totalShots_value", "shotsOnTarget_value", "saves_value", 
                     "subIns_value", "foulsCommitted_value", "foulsSuffered_value",
                     "ownGoals_value", "offsides_value", 
                     "goalsConceded_value", "shotsFaced_value")

# Clean Data
player_data_ready <- player %>% select(all_of(columns_to_keep)) %>% na.omit()
X <- player_data_ready %>% select(-Success)
Y <- player_data_ready$Success

# Factorize explicitly (c0 vs c1)
Y <- paste0("c", Y)
Y <- as.factor(Y)
data <- data.frame(X, Success = Y)

# Split Training/Testing
set.seed(123)
train.ix <- sample(nrow(data), floor(nrow(data)/2))
training_data <- data[train.ix,]
testing_data <- data[-train.ix,]

#Random Forest

# Fit the Model
full_random_forest <- randomForest(Success ~ ., data = training_data, 
                                   ntree = 250, nodesize = 20, mtry = 5)
print(full_random_forest)


#Extract values
imp_vals <- importance(full_random_forest)
importance_data <- data.frame(feature = row.names(imp_vals), 
                              importance = imp_vals[,1]) # Using MeanDecreaseGini (or Accuracy if importance=TRUE)

importance_data$feature <- factor(importance_data$feature, 
                                  levels = importance_data$feature[order(importance_data$importance)])

# A. Plot Top 20 Factors (Purple Chart)
top_n <- min(20, nrow(importance_data)) 
top_twenty <- importance_data[order(importance_data$importance, decreasing = TRUE), ][1:top_n, ]

ggplot(top_twenty, aes(x = feature, y = importance)) + 
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", fill = "purple", width = 0.5) + 
  coord_flip() + 
  labs(title = "Top Factors: Importance", x = "Factor", y = "Importance") +
  theme_minimal()

# B. Plot Bottom 20 Factors (Gold Chart)
bottom_twenty <- importance_data[order(importance_data$importance, decreasing = FALSE), ][1:top_n, ]

ggplot(bottom_twenty, aes(x = reorder(feature, -importance), y = importance)) + 
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", fill = "gold", width = 0.5) + 
  coord_flip() + 
  labs(title = "Bottom Factors: Importance", x = "Factor", y = "Importance") +
  theme_minimal()

#Error & Prediction

# OOB Error
print(paste("OOB Error Rate:", mean(full_random_forest$err.rate[,"OOB"])))

# Confusion Matrix
y_hat_class <- predict(full_random_forest, testing_data, type = "class")
print(confusionMatrix(y_hat_class, testing_data$Success))

# ROC Curve
y_hat_vote <- predict(full_random_forest, testing_data, type = "vote")
plot(roc(testing_data$Success, y_hat_vote[,"c1"]), 
     col="green", main = "ROC Curve: Soccer Success")

# 10-Fold Cross Validation 

n_folds = 10
N <- nrow(training_data)
folds_i <- sample(rep(1:n_folds, length.out = N))
cv_acc <- numeric(n_folds)


for (k in 1:n_folds) {
  test_i <- which(folds_i == k)
  training_data.cv <- training_data[-test_i, ]
  testing_data.cv <- training_data[test_i, ] 
  
  rf.cv <- randomForest(Success ~ ., data = training_data.cv, ntree = 200)
  
  y_hat_cv <- predict(rf.cv, testing_data.cv, type="class")
  
  # Calculate Accuracy
  cm <- confusionMatrix(y_hat_cv, testing_data.cv$Success)
  cv_acc[k] <- cm$overall["Accuracy"]
}

cm
print(paste("Mean CV Accuracy:", round(mean(cv_acc), 4)))
```

```{r}
# Linear Regression GF v GA
lm_model <- lm(teamRank ~ gf + ga, data = team)
print("Linear Regression Summary (GF v GA)")
summary(lm_model)

# Plot 1: Team Rank vs. Goals For (GF)
ggplot(team, aes(x = gf, y = teamRank)) +
  geom_point(color = "darkblue", alpha = 0.7) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", col = "red", se = FALSE) +
  scale_y_reverse(limits = c(20, 1), breaks = seq(1, 20, by = 1)) +
  labs(title = "Team Rank vs. Goals For (GF)",
       x = "Goals For (GF)",
       y = "Team Rank (Lower is Better)") +
  theme_minimal()

# Plot 2: Team Rank vs. Goals Against (GA)
ggplot(team, aes(x = ga, y = teamRank)) +
  geom_point(color = "darkgreen", alpha = 0.7) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", col = "blue", se = FALSE) +
  scale_y_reverse(limits = c(20, 1), breaks = seq(1, 20, by = 1)) +
  labs(title = "Team Rank vs. Goals Against (GA)",
       x = "Goals Against (GA)",
       y = "Team Rank (Lower is Better)") +
  theme_minimal()

autoplot(lm_model, which = 1:6, ncol = 3, label.size = 5)
```

```{r}
#Random Forest Team Data

columns_to_keep <- c("Success", "wins", "ties", 
                     "losses", "gf", "ga", 
                     "gd", "clean_sheet")
# Clean Data
team_data_ready <- team %>% select(all_of(columns_to_keep)) %>% na.omit()

X <- team_data_ready %>% select(-Success)
Y <- team_data_ready$Success
Y <- paste0("c", Y)
Y <- as.factor(Y)

data <- data.frame(X, Success = Y)

# Split Training/Testing
set.seed(123)
train.ix <- sample(nrow(data), floor(nrow(data)/2))
training_data <- data[train.ix,]
testing_data <- data[-train.ix,]

# Random Forest
full_random_forest <- randomForest(Success ~ ., data = training_data, 
                                   ntree = 250, nodesize = 20, mtry = 5)

print(full_random_forest)


# Extract importance values
imp_vals <- importance(full_random_forest)
importance_data <- data.frame(feature = row.names(imp_vals), 
                              importance = imp_vals[,1])
importance_data$feature <- factor(importance_data$feature, 
                                  levels = importance_data$feature[order
                                            (importance_data$importance)])

# A. Top 20 Factors (Purple Chart)
top_n <- min(20, nrow(importance_data)) 
top_twenty <- importance_data[order(importance_data$importance, 
                                    decreasing = TRUE), ][1:top_n, ]

ggplot(top_twenty, aes(x = feature, y = importance)) + 
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", fill = "purple", width = 0.5) + 
  coord_flip() + 
  labs(title = "Top Factors: Importance", x = "Factor", y = "Importance") +
  theme_minimal()

# B. Bottom 20 Factors (Gold Chart)
bottom_twenty <- importance_data[order(importance_data$importance, 
                                       decreasing = FALSE), ][1:top_n, ]

ggplot(bottom_twenty, aes(x = reorder(feature, -importance), y = importance)) + 
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", fill = "gold", width = 0.5) + 
  coord_flip() + 
  labs(title = "Bottom Factors: Importance", x = "Factor", y = "Importance") +
  theme_minimal()

# Error & Prediction 

# OOB Error
print(paste("OOB Error Rate:", mean(full_random_forest$err.rate[,"OOB"])))

# Confusion Matrix
y_hat_class <- predict(full_random_forest, testing_data, type = "class")
print(confusionMatrix(y_hat_class, testing_data$Success))

# ROC Curve
y_hat_vote <- predict(full_random_forest, testing_data, type = "vote")
plot(roc(testing_data$Success, y_hat_vote[,"c1"]), 
     col="green", main = "ROC Curve: Soccer Success")

# 10-Fold Cross Validation 

n_folds = 10
N <- nrow(training_data)
folds_i <- sample(rep(1:n_folds, length.out = N))
cv_acc <- numeric(n_folds)

for (k in 1:n_folds) {
  test_i <- which(folds_i == k)
  training_data.cv <- training_data[-test_i, ]
  testing_data.cv <- training_data[test_i, ]

  rf.cv <- randomForest(Success ~ ., data = training_data.cv, ntree = 200)
  
  y_hat_cv <- predict(rf.cv, testing_data.cv, type="class")
  
  # Calculate Accuracy
  cm <- confusionMatrix(y_hat_cv, testing_data.cv$Success)
  cv_acc[k] <- cm$overall["Accuracy"]
}

cm
print(paste("Mean CV Accuracy:", round(mean(cv_acc), 4)))
```

```{r}
team_agg <- player %>%

    Total_Yellows = sum(yellowCards_value, na.rm = TRUE),
    Total_Reds = sum(redCards_value, na.rm = TRUE),
    Total_Appearances = sum(appearances_value, na.rm = TRUE),
    Total_SubIns = sum(subIns_value, na.rm = TRUE),
    Total_FoulsCommitted = sum(foulsCommitted_value, na.rm = TRUE),
    Total_FoulsSuffered = sum(foulsSuffered_value, na.rm = TRUE),
    Total_OwnGoals = sum(ownGoals_value, na.rm = TRUE),
    Total_Offsides = sum(offsides_value, na.rm = TRUE),
    Total_ShotsOnTarget = sum(shotsOnTarget_value, na.rm = TRUE),
    Total_Shots = sum(totalShots_value, na.rm = TRUE),
    Total_ShotsFaced = sum(shotsFaced_value, na.rm = TRUE),
    Total_Saves = sum(saves_value, na.rm = TRUE),
    Total_Conceded = sum(goalsConceded_value, na.rm = TRUE),
    Standing = mean(Standing, na.rm = TRUE)
  )

# Success Target (Top 10 vs Bottom 10)
team_agg$Success <- ifelse(team_agg$Standing <= 10, 1, 0)
team_agg$Success <- as.factor(team_agg$Success)
```

```{r}
#PCA on player stats

columns_for_pca <- c(
    "appearances_value", "subIns_value", "foulsCommitted_value",
    "foulsSuffered_value", "yellowCards_value", "redCards_value", 
    "ownGoals_value", "goalAssists_value", "offsides_value", 
    "shotsOnTarget_value", "totalShots_value", "totalGoals_value", 
    "shotsFaced_value", "saves_value", "goalsConceded_value"
)

player_clean <- player[, columns_for_pca]
player_clean <- na.omit(player_clean)

full_clean <- player %>%
  select(all_of(c("Standing", columns_for_pca))) %>%
  na.omit()

X <- full_clean[, -1] 
Y <- full_clean$Standing 
data <- data.frame(Y, X)
names(data)[1] = "Standing"

set.seed(123)
train.ix <- sample(nrow(data), floor(nrow(data)) * 4 / 5 )
data.train <- data[train.ix,]
data.test <- data[-train.ix,]

trainX <- as.matrix(data.train[,-1])
testX <- as.matrix(data.test[,-1])
trainY <- as.matrix(data.train[,1])
testY <- as.matrix(data.test[,1])


# Implement PCA
if(!require("FactoMineR")) install.packages("FactoMineR")
if(!require("factoextra")) install.packages("factoextra")
library(FactoMineR)
library(factoextra)

pca.player <- PCA(trainX, graph = FALSE, ncp = 10, scale.unit = TRUE) 


# Scree Plot  
fviz_screeplot(pca.player, addlabels = TRUE, ylim = c(0, 50),
               main = "Scree Plot: Player Stats")

var <- get_pca_var(pca.player)
head(var$contrib)

# Visualize PC1
fviz_contrib(pca.player, choice = "var", axes = 1, top = 20,
             title = "Contribution to PC1")

# Visualize  PC2
fviz_contrib(pca.player, choice = "var", axes = 2, top = 20,
             title = "Contribution to PC2")


# PCR (Principal Component Regression)

trainX_pca <- pca.player$ind$coord 
trainX_pca <- data.frame(trainX_pca)
names(trainX_pca) <- paste0("PC", 1:10)

testX_pca <- predict(pca.player, newdata = testX)
testX_pca <- data.frame(testX_pca$coord)
names(testX_pca) <- paste0("PC", 1:10)

tempData <- data.frame(Standing = trainY, trainX_pca)

lm.pca <- lm(Standing ~ ., data = tempData)
summary(lm.pca)

y_hat <- predict(lm.pca, testX_pca)

print(paste("Correlation:", cor(y_hat, testY)))
mse <- mean((y_hat - testY)^2)
print(paste("MSE:", mse))

autoplot(lm.pca, which = 1:6, ncol = 3, label.size = 5)
```
